Things every man should be able
to fix himself

1. A dead car battery

Cables, red to red, black to ground.

2. A running toilet

The flapper costs less than a coffee.

3. A broken light switch

Power off first. Always.

4. A hole in the wall

Patch, sand, paint.

5. Anything, once you understand
how it works
